title: 8 Best Auto Dialers for Sales Reps in 2026 & Beyond
summary: Boost sales call volume with the best auto dialers for sales reps in 2026. Compare Trellus AI, Orum, Nooks, PhoneBurner, Kixie, CloudTalk, and more.
body_markdown:
If your reps still dial numbers by hand, they are losing hours every week to busy signals, voicemails, and wrong numbers.


The best **auto dialers for sales reps** fix that by automating the mechanical parts of calling placing the call, detecting voicemails, dropping pre recorded messages, and logging everything to your CRM so reps spend their energy on live conversations instead of keypad taps. In 2026, the strongest option is **Trellus AI** , an embedded parallel dialer that runs inside the tools your team already uses, followed by proven platforms like PhoneBurner, Nooks, and Orum.


Below we rank and review the eight auto dialers that matter most this year.


For each tool you get what it is, who it is best for, its standout features, and an honest limitation no hand waving. Whether you run a two person SDR pod or a 200 seat outbound floor, this guide will help you match a dialer to your motion.


## **For sales reps, what does an auto dialer help to achieve?**


[An auto dialer is software](https://www.trellus.ai/post/what-is-an-auto-dialer) that dials phone numbers automatically from a call list, connecting a rep only when a live human answers. That single shift, removing manual dialing, is what drives **sequential contact dialing and call volume acceleration** . Instead of 40 to 50 dials in an hour, a rep can push through hundreds.


Modern dialers layer on more than speed. Expect **automated voicemail drop and call logging** so reps leave a consistent message with one click and never forget to write a note; **real time call recording and transcription** for coaching and QA; **lead list management and contact prioritization** so the highest intent accounts surface first; and deep **CRM integration and activity capture** that syncs dispositions back to Salesforce or HubSpot without copy paste.


Auto dialers come in flavors. Power (single line) dialers call one number at a time. Parallel dialers ring several lines at once and bridge you to whoever picks up first. Predictive dialers use algorithms to over dial across a team.


If you want the full breakdown of pacing models, read our deep dive on parallel dialer vs predictive dialer. And if you want a dialer that also coaches reps mid call, look at the[newer category of the AI dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/post/what-is-an-ai-dialer) .


## **How we evaluated these tools?**


We weighed connect rate impact, ease of adoption (does it live inside your workflow or force a new app?), coaching and analytics depth, integration breadth, compliance controls, and price relative to value.


We also cross checked user[sentiment against the G2 auto dialer category](https://www.g2.com/categories/auto-dialer) to keep the reviews grounded in real buyer feedback rather than vendor marketing.

## **1. Trellus AI: best overall auto dialer for sales reps**


**What it is:** Trellus is an AI powered sales acceleration platform whose signature product is an **embedded parallel dialer** .


Instead of making reps context switch into a separate calling app, this tool runs *inside* the


tools they already work in Salesloft, Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot, Salesforce, and more through a lightweight Chrome extension. Reps open their normal cadence, hit dial, and Trellus handles the rest.


**Best for:** SDR, BDR, and AE teams running high volume outbound who want to keep dialing inside their existing sales engagement platform, plus remote and hybrid teams that need live coaching and visibility.


**Standout features:**


• **Parallel dialing** across up to roughly five live lines to multiply live connects, with automated voicemail drop and call logging back to the CRM.


• **Real time AI coaching** on screen during calls objection handling, competitor battle cards, and customizable talk tracks so reps improve while they dial. It also scores 100% of calls automatically, not just a sample, surfacing the behavior gaps between top and bottom performers.


• **AI voice agents and a 24/7 practice partner** reps can rehearse against, plus a virtual sales floors experience for shared listening, call blitzes, and live coaching.


**Limitation:** Trellus is a calling and conversation execution layer, not a full CRM or a B2B contact database. You still bring your own data provider and SEP.


## **2. PhoneBurner: best power dialer for consistent single line calling**


**What it is:** PhoneBurner is a long established, single line power dialer known for reliability and clean call quality. It dials one contact at a time with no awkward connection delay, which keeps conversations feeling natural.


**Best for:** Teams and solo reps who prioritize conversation quality and a delay free connect over raw parallel volume think financial services, insurance, and relationship driven B2B.


**Standout features:**


• Delay free connection technology that eliminates the "telemarketer pause" prospects associate with dialers.


• One click voicemail drop and email follow up, plus a built in cadence and workflow builder for lead list management and contact prioritization.


**Limitation:** As a single line dialer, PhoneBurner cannot match the live connect throughput of parallel tools, so very high volume SDR floors may outgrow it. Its native AI coaching is lighter than newer entrants.


## **3. Nooks: best for AI assisted parallel dialing and sales floor energy**


**What it is:** Nooks is a parallel dialing platform with a strong virtual sales floor and AI features aimed at SDR teams.


It rings multiple lines and filters out voicemails and bad numbers before connecting a rep.


**Best for:** Mid market and enterprise SDR teams that run coordinated call blitzes and want a collaborative, remote friendly calling environment.


**Standout features:**


• Multi line parallel dialer with AI that skips answering machines, so reps mostly hear live humans. • Virtual sales floor for co working call sessions plus AI driven call analytics and coaching.


**Limitation:** Nooks sits at a higher price point that can be steep for small teams, and it operates as its own app rather than living natively inside every SEP. If you are weighing options, our AI sales prospecting tools coverage across the cluster is worth a look.


## **4. Orum: best for enterprise outbound calling speed**


**What it is:** Orum is a live conversation platform built around a fast, AI powered parallel dialer designed to maximize connects for large outbound teams.


**Best for:** Enterprise and scaling SDR organizations that measure success in conversations per hour and need robust analytics.


**Standout features:**


• High throughput parallel dialing with machine detection that routes reps only to live answers. • Salesforce and Outreach integrations plus manager analytics dashboards for real time call recording and transcription review.


**Limitation:** Orum is priced for teams, not individuals, and its value depends on high call volume; light users will not recover the cost. For a head to head with a key rival,[see our Orum vs Koncert](https://www.trellus.ai/post/orum-vs-koncert) comparison.


## **5. Kixie: best for CRM native power dialing and SMS**


**What it is:** Kixie is a sales engagement and power dialer platform with strong click to call, local presence, and integrated SMS, popular with HubSpot and Pipedrive users.


**Best for:** SMB and mid market teams that want a tightly CRM integrated dialer plus texting in one tool. **Standout features:**


• Local presence dialing and automated voicemail drop to lift answer rates.


• Two way SMS and CRM integration with automatic activity capture, so calls and texts log themselves.


**Limitation:** Kixie leans single line/power dialing rather than true multi line parallel, so peak connect volume trails dedicated parallel dialers. Advanced AI coaching is not its core strength.


## **6. CloudTalk: best for global teams needing telephony depth**


**What it is:** CloudTalk is a cloud based business phone system with a robust outbound dialer, extensive international numbers, and call center features.


**Best for:** Distributed teams and support plus sales orgs that need reliable global telephony alongside outbound dialing.


**Standout features:**


• Power and smart dialers with call recording, IVR, and a large library of international phone numbers. • Deep integrations with CRMs and helpdesks for unified activity capture across sales and service.


**Limitation:** CloudTalk is more of a full telephony suite than a purpose built SDR speed dialer, so parallel dialing throughput and sales specific AI coaching are not its focus. Configuration can be heavier than a plug in tool.

Teams that outgrow it often[review PowerDialer.ai alternatives](https://www.trellus.ai/post/top-12-powerdialer-ai-alternatives) for more coaching and multi line power.


## **8. Salesfinity: best budget parallel dialer for lean SDR teams**


**What it is:** Salesfinity is an emerging AI parallel dialer aimed at helping smaller SDR teams boost connect rates affordably.


**Best for:** Startups and lean outbound teams that want multi line dialing and AI assistance without enterprise pricing.


**Standout features:**


• AI parallel dialing that filters voicemails and connects reps to live answers.


• Call recording, transcription, and CRM integration with activity capture built in.


**Limitation:** As a newer, smaller vendor, Salesfinity has a thinner integration catalog and less proven scale than Orum or Nooks, so large enterprises may find gaps in reporting and admin controls.


## **How to choose the right auto dialer for your team**


Start with your motion, not the feature list. A few practical filters:


• **Volume and connect goals.** If reps need to triple live conversations, prioritize a parallel dialer (Trellus, Nooks, Orum, Salesfinity). If conversation quality and a delay free connect matter most, a power dialer (PhoneBurner, Kixie) may serve you better.


• **Workflow fit.** Every context switch costs momentum. Tools that embed inside your SEP like Trellus inside Salesloft, Outreach, or Apollo protect reps' focus and lift SDR efficiency. Standalone apps can be powerful but add a tab to babysit.


• **Coaching and analytics.** Recording is table stakes; look for real time guidance and full coverage call scoring if you want to close the gap between top and bottom performers.


• **Compliance controls.** DNC scrubbing, consent tracking, and abandonment safeguards are non-negotiable for outbound at scale.


• **Budget reality.** Match seat cost to expected volume. A cheap dialer a rep barely uses is expensive; a premium one that doubles connects can pay for itself in a week.


Pair whichever tool you pick with strong fundamentals; the best dialer amplifies a good process but cannot rescue a weak one. Our guide to cold calling success covers the scripts and habits that turn more connects into more meetings.


### **An important note on compliance**


Speed is only an asset when it is legal. In the United States, autodialing and pre recorded messages fall under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act, and rules on what counts as an autodialer, consent, and call abandonment continue to evolve.


Before you scale volume,[review current guidance from the FCC's rules on autodialers and the TCPA](https://www.fcc.gov/sites/default/files/tcpa-rules.pdf) and build DNC scrubbing and consent tracking into your process. Reputable dialers give you the controls; using them is on you.


## **Frequently asked questions**


**What is the difference between an auto dialer and a predictive dialer?**


An auto dialer is the broad category for software that dials automatically.


A predictive dialer is one type that uses algorithms to over dial across a team and predict agent availability.


Parallel dialers, by contrast, are agent-controlled and ring several lines for a single rep. See our full comparison for details.


**Are auto dialers legal for sales reps?**


Yes, when used in compliance with regulations like the TCPA in the US and equivalent local laws. That means honoring do not call lists, respecting consent requirements, and keeping call abandonment within limits.


Choose a dialer with built in compliance controls and configure them properly.


**Do auto dialers integrate with my CRM?**


The best ones do. Look for native integration with your CRM and sales engagement platform so calls, dispositions, and notes log automatically.


Trellus, for instance, works inside Salesloft, Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot, and Salesforce.


**Will a parallel dialer hurt call quality?**


It can if list hygiene is poor, because overdialing bad data creates awkward connects.


With clean lists, verified numbers, and voicemail detection, a parallel dialer delivers more live conversations without degrading quality, and modern AI dialers reduce the connection lag that used to signal a robocall.


**The Bottom Line**


The right auto dialer turns a rep's hour from a handful of dials into a stream of real conversations. For most sales teams in 2026, **Trellus AI** is the best starting point: it embeds parallel dialing, real time coaching, and 100% call scoring directly inside the tools reps already use, at an aggressive price.


If you need delay free single line calling, PhoneBurner shines; for enterprise scale speed, Orum and Nooks deliver; and budget conscious teams have real options in Salesfinity and PowerDialer.ai.
